name: Glide menus
author: Igor Ryzhkov
description: Cantina's cascading context menus with caelestia-style motion: panes grow out of their anchor and the selection highlight glides between rows. Right-click the desktop, click the bar button, or press a key over any window.

barWidget.description: Cascading Omarchy menu with expressive motion, on the bar button and the desktop right-click

schema.label: Animations
schema.description: Pane entrances grow out of their anchor and the selection highlight glides between rows with a caelestia-style stretch. Off restores the instant behavior of the original context menus.

schema.label: Keybinding opens the menu
schema.description: Where a keybinding or IPC summon places the menu: the middle of the focused screen, or under the pointer. The desktop right-click always opens at the click.

schema.label: Escape closes the whole menu
schema.description: Escape dismisses the entire cascade. Off makes Escape walk back one pane at a time (clearing the type-ahead first), like the original context menus; Left arrow and right-click always walk back.

schema.label: Hover moves the selection
schema.description: Pointer hover moves the selection and opens submenus after the dwell delay. Off leaves selection to the keyboard and opens submenus only on click.

schema.label: Right-click the desktop to open the menu
schema.description: Puts a transparent catcher above the wallpaper and below every window, so a right-click on bare desktop opens the menu under the pointer. Off leaves the desktop to whatever else wants it, and the bar button and the keybinding still work.

schema.label: Double-click the desktop for the wallpaper picker
schema.description: The catcher takes the clicks Omarchy's background plugin would otherwise get, so it hands this one back: double-click still opens omarchy-theme-bg-switcher. Only matters while the setting above is on.

schema.label: List applications in the menu
schema.description: Fills the Apps submenu in from the same library the launcher reads, icons and all, and type to narrow it. Off sends Apps to the built-in Omarchy menu instead, which searches rather than scrolls.

schema.label: Open a submenu after
schema.description: Milliseconds the pointer has to rest on a row before its submenu opens. Long enough that a diagonal sweep toward an already-open submenu does not tear it down on the way past; short enough not to feel like waiting. 0 opens instantly.

schema.label: Pane width
schema.description: In the shell's spacing units, so it tracks the rest of your scaling. Wider suits long application names; narrower keeps a deep cascade on one screen.

schema.label: Right-click on the bar button runs
schema.description: What a right-click on the bar button does. Matches the built-in Omarchy menu button, which opens a terminal. Empty to do nothing.
